root_cause.text: The `vxlan_na_create` function lacks validation of ND option lengths against the remaining option area and the required payload size for source LLADDR, enabling out-of-bounds reads from a crafted Neighbor Solicitation packet.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds checks for `i + (ns->opt[i+1] << 3) > ns_olen` to prevent advancing beyond the option span, and requires `(ns->opt[i+1] << 3) >= sizeof(struct nd_opt_hdr) + ETH_ALEN` before reading the source link-layer address, fixing the missing validation.
